note: The AlgoLift strategy node's own formula on the cases TA-Lib was compared on (talib/macd.json, MACD). It differs from TA-Lib by a convention, so these numbers are its own: Seeds each average on the first bars of the series, so macd_line starts at bar slow_period - 1. TA-Lib seeds the fast average on the bars that end where the slow average's seed ends, and publishes every output only from the signal line's first bar (slow_period + signal_period - 2). The values differ at the start and converge as the averages forget their seeds (on the fixture's bars, by bar 180 at 12, 26 and 9). Adds macd_line_slope, signal_line_slope and histogram_slope, which TA-Lib does not compute.
